properties.site-address: Former Biwaters site, land off Derby Road, Clay Cross
properties.notes: Planning permission 17/00247/RM has been conditionally approved for 166 dwellings on the west side of the site pursuant to outline planning permission 08/01085/OL. 10 out of 825 dwellings have been completed in 2017/18.. Outline application for a mixed-use development, comprising: residential use (C3), employment-generating uses with employment (B1, B2, B8), local centre (A1, A2, A3, A4 and/or A5), hotel (C1) and/or care home (C2); and public open space, landscaping, highway works and associated infrastructure.
